text_block_list.text:
Everyone has times when they stumble or 
things just don't go their way...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's pathetic, even if I say so myself... 
To run 12 races this year and only come 
away with 2 wins...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're still doing totally fine, Ikuno~. I 
might be nearing the end of my shelf life 
soon...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should spend the rest of this year 
starting over from amateur freestyle 
races...

However, Tokai Teio's "giving up on 
returning this year" was a massive 
shockwave that went far beyond an 
individual setback...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... was dreaming of it... The day 
they'd run with Teio, who'd grown even 
stronger in the autumn...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And yet... this is just...

Nice Nature's depression was especially 
severe. Because she had worked so hard, 
aiming for that very moment.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I get why you're bummed, Nature, but 
you've got nothing to feel down about.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio gave up, but I know she hasn't really 
given up!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, disappointed, but don't be 
disappointed? Giving up, but not giving 
up...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I don't get what you mean at all. Trainer, 
what are you...

I felt like I understood a little. Just as 
I was about to explain—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna go check on Teio herself!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, hey! Twin Turbo!

In a panic, the two of them chased after 
it.

Having painfully given up on the Kikuka 
Sho, Tokai Teio was resting. Wondering how 
she was doing, I peeked through the 
window, and...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: One... two...! One... two...!

She is focused... There didn't seem to be 
any dark shadows lingering on her face.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oh, hard at work, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turbo?! That girl has no tact at all, 
barging in like that...!

Somehow, I felt like it would be okay. So 
I stopped Nice Nature and decided to just 
watch over them.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio, it's a bummer about your injury. But 
Turbo knows the truth!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio isn't the kind of Umamusume to 
be stopped by something like this.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo knows better than anyone just how 
amazing Tokai Teio is!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you. But...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I ended up causing a bit of trouble for 
everyone, huh? Saying I'd enter, then 
saying I wouldn't."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Though it's still the result of giving it 
my all, in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, can't be helped. People are 
just focusing way too much on the Kikuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Even if we don't rush, Teio will 
definitely come back! Stronger than ever 
before!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't know how strong I can get, 
but that's definitely the plan.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just because I didn't make it in time for 
the Kikuka Sho, I'm not giving up. Because 
I have—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because I still have dreams I want to 
fulfill!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: A dream... I want to come true...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see! Teio, you really are awesome! 
Turbo's not gonna lose either!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo still has dreams to fulfill too! And 
things Turbo wants! That's why...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Let's train hard so neither of us loses! 
Right, Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If anyone starts worrying for no reason, 
Turbo will tell 'em: "Don't you 
underestimate Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gyah!

Twin Turbo walked away. Calling it a 
rivalry... might just be one-sided on her 
part, though.

Even so, Twin Turbo believed in Tokai 
Teio's pure, unadulterated strength more 
than anyone else.

—And so, in a corner of the cafeteria, 
Twin Turbo and the disheartened group 
gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"So yeah, Teio is totally fine, Nature. So 
you gotta do your best too!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If you don't take this seriously, Teio's 
gonna laugh at you. And Turbo, too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey! Teio is one thing, but why is 
Turbo laughing at me too?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Teio would laugh at me, huh.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Compared to Teio who's injured, you 
get to run "freestyle," Palmer! So what's 
the problem?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And Ikuno, too! Even in the races where 
you didn't get 1st place, if you add them 
all up, it's basically like getting 1st 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
2nd place + 3rd place + 2nd place = 1st 
place! Right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I can't say I entirely agree with that 
math... but Turbo-san does have a point."

Twin Turbo's encouragement, lent through 
the authority of Tokai Teio, seemed to 
have quite an effect.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! Ikuno, let's give it our all! 
Moping around isn't gonna solve anything!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. Sometimes it's better not to 
overthink things with logic.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Say what you will, Turbo really 
is the ultimate mood maker, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Turbo is always the 
strongest!

With a look of sheer triumph. âAnd right 
at that moment.
Um, excuse me for a moment~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you share some of that 
"gyaaaaah!" energy with me?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hm? Uuum...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's your familiar Machikane Tannhauser. 
I'm still in the Junior Class, having just 
debuted recently~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying my best here, but I just can't 
seem to catch the wave. So, pretty please 
lend me a hand~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes? What can I do for you?
choice_data_list:
The girl who crashed the summer fest 
after-party!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Crashing the afterparty... without 
permission? Ah, that music festival back 
then...?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? Were we not supposed to just 
jump in whenever we wanted?

"...Looks like she just realized it. She 
really is quite an airheaded horse girl."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna join us, of course you can, 
Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have confidence, just copy 
Turbo for now! It'll work out somehow!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll be sure to follow your example!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us start by determining whom I 
should study under. I look forward to 
working with you, Tannhauser-san."

And so, a sixth member joined Twin Turbo's 
circle of friends.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer. If Teio won't be able 
to make it back, what should our next 
target be?

We certainly have to think about it. If we 
can't predict the day of her comeback, 
then for now...

Looking ahead to that distant 
confrontation, I have no choice but to 
build up enough strength to rival her. If 
that is the case—
choice_data_list:
Let's prepare by rotating through graded 
races.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Prepare!? For Teio!? Sounds good, let's do 
it! Turbo agrees--!!

Without even asking for details, Twin 
Turbo agreed. In the end, taking current 
abilities into account—

I set a goal to 'Place in the top 3 in 
GIII or higher races 3 times' by next May.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Placing 3rd or better 3 times in GⅢ or 
higher races means... Um..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"What happens if I win a G1? Does that 
still count as 1 time?"
choice_data_list: Of course, that's still fine with me.
Of course, that's still totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then there's no problem at all! For 
the rest of the year, Turbo will...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll wiiin the Kikuka Sho without Teio!! 
And then, and then~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win the Arima Kinen too! I'm 
just gonna win 'em aaall!

I had set a modest goal after weighing 
various factors, but Twin Turbo had 
absolutely no intention of staying within 
those confines.

—Aim high. At the same time, let's make 
sure to properly complete "place in the 
top 3 in a GIII or higher race 3 times."
